purpose: Southern IW processing development; adaptive metadata/wind selection, not operational or unbiased evaluation
selection_rule: Rank January southern HH/HV IW candidates by nearest-hour ERA5 10m wind at catalogue overlap centroid; apply zero-height annotation and frozen-test exclusion guards, prefer distinct acquisitions and locations; no SAR pixels inspected.; angular polygon-overlap proxies >=0.8 southern and >=0.95 AOI; centroid -57..-46 longitude, 44..49 latitude; distinct dates; first three passing unchanged MarineGeocoder metadata guards
